topic: How does L-DACS integration impact spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces?
consensus_response: L-DACS integration impacts spectrum sharing by introducing interference through FDD (L-DACS1) and mitigating it via TDD (L-DACS2). Adaptive antenna systems enhance sharing through beamforming and null-steering, while Doppler shift affects signal propagation. Machine learning optimizes L-DACS parameters for efficient utilization.
reference_context: L-DACS operates in the L-band, with two candidates: L-DACS1 using FDD and L-DACS2 using TDD, affecting spectrum allocation and interference.
